news.title: Investor sentiment improves as stock rises 29%
news.body: After last week's 29% share price gain to ₹9.58, the stock trades at a trailing P/E ratio of 23.2x. Average trailing P/E is 24x in the Retail Distributors industry in India. Total returns to shareholders of 347% over the past three years.

news.title: New major risk - Share price stability
news.body: The company's share price has been highly volatile over the past 3 months. It is more volatile than 90% of Indian stocks, typically moving 9.2% a week. This is considered a major risk. Share price volatility increases the risk of potential losses in the short-term as the stock tends to have larger drops in price more frequently than other stocks. It may also indicate the stock is highly sensitive to market conditions or economic conditions rather than being sensitive to its own business performance, which may also be inconsistent. Currently, the following risks have been identified for the company: Major Risks Share price has been highly volatile over the past 3 months (9.2% average weekly change). news.body: After last week's 19% share price decline to ₹6.63, the stock trades at a trailing P/E ratio of 16.1x. Average trailing P/E is 21x in the Retail Distributors industry in India. Total returns to shareholders of 137% over the past three years.

news.title: New minor risk - Profit margin trend
news.body: The company's profit margins are lower than last year and have reduced by more than 30%. Net profit margin: 1.5% Last year net profit margin: 2.7% This is considered a minor risk. A large drop in profit margin could indicate the company does not have strong competitive advantages or it is yet to establish itself and its core business. Even if it is a well established business, this may make it a much riskier investment than one that has a combination of proven competitive advantages and a stable or growing profit margin. Currently, the following risks have been identified for the company: Major Risk Market cap is less than US$10m (₹133.2m market cap, or US$1.47m). Minor Risks Share price has been volatile over the past 3 months (8.4% average weekly change). Profit margins are more than 30%

news.title: Third quarter 2026 earnings released: EPS: ₹0.04 (vs ₹0.09 in 3Q 2025)
news.body: Third quarter 2026 results: EPS: ₹0.04 (down from ₹0.09 in 3Q 2025). Revenue: ₹78.0m (up 12% from 3Q 2025). Net income: ₹548.0k (down 55% from 3Q 2025). Profit margin: 0.7% (down from 1.8% in 3Q 2025). The decrease in margin was driven by higher expenses. Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has increased by 108% per year but the company’s share price has only increased by 43% per year, which means it is significantly lagging earnings growth.

news.title: Second quarter 2026 earnings released: EPS: ₹0.26 (vs ₹0.096 in 2Q 2025)
news.body: Second quarter 2026 results: EPS: ₹0.26 (up from ₹0.096 in 2Q 2025). Revenue: ₹173.6m (up 234% from 2Q 2025). Net income: ₹3.65m (up 170% from 2Q 2025). Profit margin: 2.1% (down from 2.6% in 2Q 2025). The decrease in margin was driven by higher expenses. Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has increased by 71% per year but the company’s share price has only increased by 29% per year, which means it is significantly lagging earnings growth.
